prompt: This template is built to be driven by coding agents — read AGENTS.md first. There is no database and no login: `pnpm install && pnpm dev` is the whole setup. AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY in .env.local is only needed for assistant turns; the notes UI is fully verifiable without it. Gate every change with `pnpm verify`. NEVER run `eve build` while `pnpm dev` is running — it corrupts eve's dev cache (recovery: `rm -rf .eve .workflow-data`).
